note: The lead set work to null on 2026-10-31: the Lei do Trabalho leaves artistic work to special legislation that wasn't read, so neither the age nor what a young performer may do is settled by the text read. Majority: null. The Civil Code and the Family Law were not found on the Supreme Court's legislation page (ts.gov.mz/legislacao) nor the government portal; not read. Work: Lei n.º 13/2023 de 25 de Agosto, Lei do Trabalho (Boletim da República, I Série, n.º 165, 25 August 2023; the Supreme Court's copy), revoking Lei 23/2007: art. 29(1) the minimum age of admission to work is 18; art. 29(2) exceptionally the employer may admit a minor who has completed 15, with his legal representative's authorisation; art. 29(3) none under 18 in unhealthy, dangerous or heavy work; art. 29(4) limits a minor's normal hours (25 a week and 5 a day per the reports read in a search, not checked against the text), which the form doesn't hold. The form holds 15, the youngest age the Law lets a person be employed, with the guardian's authorisation (my reading of 'in general' against the Law's 18). Performers: the Law's article on special regimes (regimes especiais) leaves artistic work to special legislation, which was not found or read; nothing read lets one under 15 perform, so the form holds barred (my reading, to be checked against that special legislation). Service: null. The Military Service Law (Lei 32/2009) was not read.

sources.title: Lei n.º 13/2023 de 25 de Agosto, Lei do Trabalho (Boletim da República, I Série, n.º 165), Tribunal Supremo
sources.said: A idade mínima de admissão para o trabalho é de 18 anos. 2. Excepcionalmente, o empregador pode admitir ao trabalho o menor que tenha completado 15 anos de idade, mediante autorização do seu representante legal. ...
